query:

UNION ALL
SELECT 'periods', country, COUNT(*) FROM periods GROUP BY country
UNION ALL
SELECT 'forecast_data', s.country, COUNT(*) FROM forecast_data fd JOIN skus s ON fd.skuId = s.id GROUP BY s.country
UNION ALL
SELECT 'ssof_versions', country, COUNT(*) FROM ssof_versions GROUP BY country;
